en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a picturesque building surrounded by trees, labeled 'Bad Pyrmont Bomberg-Restaurant :: C. Lange.' There's a sign in the foreground reading 'Bomberg Restaurant.' The reverse of the postcard shows handwritten German text, a German stamp, and the printed word 'Postkarte,' as well as a stamp from the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.
